description_en: Queries the aggregate routes in the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表下的聚合路由
name: DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table of the Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器路由表ID
parameters.name: transit_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the aggregate route
parameters.name: transit_route_table_aggregation_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value on your client to ensure that it is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If this is your first query or no next query is to be sent, ignore this parameter.
If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned from the last API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

Description.description_en: The description of the aggregate route

Name.description_en: The name of the aggregate route

RouteType.description_en:
The route type of the aggregate route.

Valid value: Static, which indicates a static route. After the aggregate route is propagated to a VPC-connected instance, it becomes a custom route entry by default
RouteType.description_zh:
聚合路由的路由类型。

仅取值：Static，表示静态路由。聚合路由被传播至VPC实例后，默认为自定义路由条目

Scope.description_en:
The propagation scope of the aggregate route.

Valid value: VPC, which indicates that the aggregate route is propagated to all VPC-connected instances that are associated with the route table of the current Enterprise Edition transit router and have route synchronization enabled
Scope.description_zh:
聚合路由的传播范围。

仅取值：VPC，表示向已与当前企业版转发路由器路由表创建关联转发关系并已开启路由同步功能的所有VPC实例传播聚合路由

ScopeList.description_en:
The list of propagation scopes for the aggregate route.
You must specify at least one of the propagation scope and the propagation scope list. We recommend that you specify the propagation scope list. The elements in the propagation scope list cannot be the same as the value of the propagation scope
ScopeList.description_zh:
聚合路由的传播范围列表。
聚合路由传播范围和聚合路由传播范围列表必须至少选择一个属性，建议使用聚合路由传播范围列表；聚合路由传播范围列表中元素不能与聚合路由传播范围的值重复
ScopeList.itemName: 聚合路由的传播范围列表

items.description_en:
The propagation scope of the aggregate route. Valid values:

VPC: propagates the aggregate route to all VPC-connected instances that are associated with the route table of the current Enterprise Edition transit router and have route synchronization enabled.
VBR: propagates the aggregate route to all virtual border router (VBR) instances that are attached to the current Enterprise Edition transit router.
Peer: propagates the aggregate route to all transit routers that have established inter-region connections with the current Enterprise Edition transit router.
VPN: propagates the aggregate route to all VPN instances that are attached to the current Enterprise Edition transit router.
ECR: propagates the aggregate route to all Express Connect Router (ECR) instances that are attached to the current Enterprise Edition transit router
items.description_zh:
聚合路由的传播范围列表。
取值：

VPC，表示向已与当前企业版转发路由器路由表创建关联转发关系并已开启路由同步功能的所有VPC实例传播聚合路由。
VBR，表示向已加载到当前企业版转发路由器的VBR实例传播聚合路由。
Peer，表示向已与当前企业版转发路由器建立了跨地域连接的转发路由器传播聚合路由。
VPN，表示向已加载到当前企业版转发路由器的VPN实例传播聚合路由。
ECR，表示向已加载到当前企业版转发路由器的ECR实例传播聚合路由

Status.description_en:
The propagation status of the aggregate route.

AllConfigured: The aggregate route is delivered to all VPC-connected instances.
Configuring: The aggregate route is being delivered.
ConfigFailed: The aggregate route failed to be delivered.
PartialConfigured: The aggregate route is not delivered to some VPC-connected instances.
Deleting: The aggregate route is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
聚合路由的传播状态。

AllConfigured：聚合路由已下发至全部VPC实例。
Configuring：聚合路由下发中。
ConfigFailed：聚合路由下发失败。
PartialConfigured：部分VPC没有被成功下发聚合路由。
Deleting：聚合路由删除中

TrRouteTableId.description_en: The ID of the route table of the Enterprise Edition transit router
TrRouteTableId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器路由表ID

TransitRouteTableAggregationCidr.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the aggregate route

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query is to be sent.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
